title: Cut Susi 0.21.51: bump the engine version and ship it from a native Linux x86_64 host
goal: Release main as 0.21.51, including the T-FLAKY1106-1 test-reliability fixes (8a490953c). GitHub Actions is off (CEO decision 2026-11-05), so release.yml no longer builds or publishes. Bump the seven engine-version manifests, Cargo.lock, the README badge and the three governance ledgers together (matching c52ed885d), and land the bump through cargo local-workflow ship on a native x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu host. Then qualify the Linux x86_64 artifact with cargo local-release and publish it as v0.21.51; the Windows x86_64 artifact is added to the same release from the CEO's Windows host. If the release tooling refuses for a structural reason, report the exact refusal instead of forging receipts, refs or coordinator trust inputs. Installed production promotion is a separate, evidence-gated step and is not claimed by this cut.
